title: 第2章 大醮天试、四相蓍草
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

所谓【大醮】，又称【科醮】【天试】，是突破大境界之时，必然要进行的一种仪式。

毕竟人乃血肉之躯，如何采炁？如何纳伟力入身？

唯有天授。

想要天授，就要完成【大醮】，如此才可承道得伟力。

胎息之境，炼化精气，肉身圆满无漏，可以空拳搏斗猛虎，赤脚追捕麋鹿，能活人之寿元大限一百二十载。

但终究是个凡人。

刀剑可伤，无有神异。

而炼炁，则是修行的第一道槛。

炼炁得成，就不算是凡人，可施展道术术法，腾云驾雾，身有神异。

而想要炼炁，就要开启【炼炁大醮】。

每一境界的【大醮】，都只有两次机会。

第一次失败，无有损伤，修行者也不会有性命之忧。

但若是第二次失败，将会有巨大的灾祸，且每个境界的灾祸都各不相同。

这就是所谓的【天恩无二】。

陆玄之所以面临如今的局面，就是因为前身在第一次【炼炁大醮】之中失败，采炁不成，将在七日之后取消【蛰院】弟子的资格。

【蛰院】是鉴天教招收预备弟子之场所。

凡【蛰院】弟子，都可在鉴天教修行九载，前三载习文，后三载读经，最后三载才开始修行。

虽然只有三载修行时光，但却足够陆玄等人修成胎息圆满。

无它，【蛰院】的待遇太好了。

鉴天教的精舍，乃是精简版的洞府，位居地支巳字第六等灵脉之上，甚至超越了诸多小宗的内门弟子灵脉之所。

放在外界，千金不换。

鉴天教的脍堂，则是提供蕴含灵气的堂食之所，一日三餐都是有灵之物。

陆玄能在三载之内，炼精得成，胎息圆满，和这脍堂密不可分。

每日的吃食，都是精气饱满，微微吐纳就可炼化的灵米灵肉，灵蔬灵汤。

仅仅是脍堂这一个待遇，不知多少散修小宗的修士就眼红羡慕。

更别提一年四季的法袍、每月按时发放的灵石，山门之中可以随心驱使的灵云。

堪称豪奢。

陆玄初次吸收原主记忆之时，也是暗自咂舌。

放在前世，这就是首都地界的单人两室一厅宿舍，三餐免费的营养食堂，永远不用花钱的定制服装，想怎么开就怎么开，不用一分油钱的“私人公车”……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The so-called [Big Jiao], also known as [Ke Jiao] and [Heavenly Trial], is a ritual that must be performed when breaking through the great realm.

After all, humans are made of flesh and blood, so how can we collect energy?How to absorb the power of Wei?

Only given by God.

If you want to be granted the gift of heaven, you must complete the [Big Jiao], only in this way can you inherit the Tao and gain great power.

In the realm of fetal breath, the essence is refined, and the physical body is perfect and flawless. You can fight tigers with bare fists, hunt elk with bare feet, and live for a maximum of one hundred and twenty years.

But he is still a human being after all.

The sword can hurt, but there is no magic.

And refining Qi is the first threshold of cultivation.

After refining Qi successfully, one is no longer considered a mortal. He can perform Taoist magic, soar into the clouds and ride in the mist, and possess supernatural powers.

If you want to refine Qi, you must activate the [Qi Refining Jiao].

There are only two chances for [Dajiao] in each realm.

If you fail the first time, there will be no harm, and the practitioner will not be in danger of his life.

But if it fails for the second time, there will be huge disasters, and the disasters in each realm are different.

This is the so-called [Tian En Wu Duo].

The reason why Lu Xuan is facing the current situation is because his predecessor failed in the first [Qi Refining Jiao]. If he fails to collect Qi, he will be disqualified from being a disciple of [Zheyuan] after seven days.

[Zheyuan] is the place where Jiantian Sect recruits preparatory disciples.

All disciples of [Zheyuan] can practice in Jiantian Sect for nine years. The first three years are to practice essays, the next three years are to read scriptures, and the last three years are to start practicing.

Although there are only three years of practice, it is enough for Lu Xuan and others to achieve the perfection of fetal breath.

Without it, the treatment in [Zheyuan] is too good.

The Jingtian Sect's Jingshe is a simplified version of the cave, ranking above the sixth level of spiritual veins of Dizhi Si, and even surpassing the spiritual veins of many small sect's inner disciples.

If you leave it to the outside world, it won't change for a thousand pieces of gold.

Jiantianjiao's Xiantang is a dining place that contains spiritual energy. Three meals a day are filled with spiritual food.

Lu Xuan was able to refine it within three years, and his fetal breath was perfect, which is inseparable from this temple.

The daily food is filled with spiritual rice, spiritual meat, and spiritual vegetable soup that are full of energy and can be refined by just breathing in and out.

Just the treatment from Pengtang made countless monks from small sects jealous and envious.

Not to mention the year-round robes, the spiritual stones distributed on time every month, and the spiritual clouds in the mountain gate that can be controlled at will.

It can be called luxurious.

When Lu Xuan absorbed the memory of the original owner for the first time, he secretly smacked his lips.

In the previous life, this was a single two-bedroom dormitory in the capital city, a nutritious canteen with three free meals, customized clothes that never cost money, a "private bus" that you can drive as you want, and that doesn't cost a penny of gas...
